description: Source code for a QUIC packet printer tool that processes and outputs human-readable information about QUIC packets, including handling different packet types and frames.

classes.name: quic::QuicPacketPrinter
classes.description: A visitor class implementing QuicFramerVisitorInterface to handle and output details of various QUIC packet components during parsing.

methods.name: QuicPacketPrinter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packet printer with a reference to a QuicFramer.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles errors encountered during packet processing, outputs error details.

methods.name: OnProtocolVersionMismatch
methods.description: Handles protocol version mismatches, updates framer version, and logs the event.

methods.name: OnPacket
methods.description: Logs when a packet is processed.

methods.name: OnUnauthenticatedHeader
methods.description: Handles unauthenticated header, outputs header info.

methods.name: OnDecryptedPacket
methods.description: Handles decrypted packets, currently supports only null encryption.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles stream frames, outputs frame data.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Handles crypto frames, outputs frame data.

methods.name: OnAckFrameEnd
methods.description: Handles end of ACK frame, outputs ECN counts if available.

methods.name: OnPacketComplete
methods.description: Called when packet processing is complete.

methods.name: OnAuthenticatedIetfStatelessResetPacket
methods.description: Handles authenticated IETF stateless reset packets.

methods.name: OnDecryptedFirstPacketInKeyPhase
methods.description: Handles first packet in new key phase.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances keys and creates decrypter for current one-rtt keys.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates encrypter for current one-rtt keys.
